podcast.title: Ambiguous Relationship to Main Band
podcast.body: Despite being a separate project, it's acknowledged that "we know they are still Death Grips and we don't understand it," highlighting the project's enigmatic connection to the primary group. "sabemos que siguen siendo los Dead Gryps y no lo entendemos."

podcast.title: Side Project of Death Grips Members
podcast.body: This project, involving MC Ride and Andy Morin, is considered a "somewhat strange" side band operating within Death Grips. Its exact nature and relationship to the main band are not fully understood. "ese proyecto un poco raro mediante que hacen en Sir Ryan y Andy Moring de IELWISE, o algo así, es como una especie de segunda banda dentro de la misma banda, no lo entendemos muy bien."
